title: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1983
PAKISTAN WATER AND
POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE XIII OF
1983
An Ordinance
further to amend Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 25th May, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Water and Power
Development Authority (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 17, W. P. Act No. XXXI of 1958

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1983
PAKISTAN WATER AND
POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE XIII OF
1983
An Ordinance
further to amend Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 25th May, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 17, W.
P. Act No. XXXI of 1958.--In the Pakistan Water and Power Development
Authority Act, 1958 (W. P. Act No. XXXI of 1958), in section 17, after
subsection (1-C) ,the following new subsection shall be added. namely :---
"(I-D)
Nothing contained in the Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969 (XXIII of 1969),
shall apply to or in relation to any person employed as a member of the
security staff of the Authority for the protection of the installa tions and
establishments of the Authority. ".
